name: Talking object

specialised.why: read from the swipe's sound form
the swipe is animated; its style row locks every element

specialised.what: speakers address each other, not the lens
specialised.why: the frame map's faces look at one another

stage_order: writing (the hook stays as the format has it)
clips (Seedance 2.5, 480p, one take, three tries at most; the locked read goes in as the clip's audio)
the locked read goes into the clip as its audio (nothing is fitted afterwards)
edit (cuts between whole takes; no repairs)

audio.on_camera: said inside the clip: the approved read goes in as the clip's audio (nothing is fitted afterwards)
audio.off_camera: the speaker's cloned voice on its own track
audio.turns: each speaker waits their turn — no overlapping murmurs

pictures.subject_zone: 15–85% of the height, said in the first prompt
pictures.only_these_things: list every prop; nothing from the swipe's own props leaks in

clips.cut_at: line or sentence boundaries, never padded
clips.upscale: local Real-ESRGAN to 1080x1920 — the picked take only (VIDEO-RULINGS V6, 2026-10-21)
clips.person_from: the section's approved picture, never a made frame
clips.restart_on_same_picture: a new shot — the storyboard's next angle or framing — cut at a line boundary; never a punch-in to hide the join (VIDEO-RULINGS V15)
clips._seedance: 2026-10-26: every clip is Seedance 2.5 at 480p, one take and three tries at most (VIDEO-RULINGS V34, MODEL-HOUSE.md); a clip is 4 s at the least

cast.reuse: banked cast first (the same presenter served four formats); new cast only for the roles a format adds (host, artist, doctors)
cast.product: real pixels — real archive clip, studio render or the turntable paste (live-action family)

hooks.shape: the hook stays as the format has it; 4–5 alternate openings swap the first scene or line (G01-H2…H6)

captions.look: ig-fb-native (Instagram/Facebook) unless the source has none

apply: line parity on every talking clip
mouths reviewed (a silent person's lips moving)
picture QC with a working reviewer

edit.method: video-edit machine cut on the voice track
edit.lip_offset: measure in each clip's own frames; one global picture offset when the whole cut is a frame off
edit.music: only when the swipe or the brief calls for it (VIDEO-RULINGS V14); then ducked about -19 dB under voice

quality_bar: every word heard, none cut off (line parity on every talking clip)
lips on the words within a frame
a silent person's lips never move on screen
every speaker sounds like their face — their own cloned voice
no third hand, no words written on clothes or walls, no garbled labels left readable
the product is the real thing at its real size and colour
the room stays the same room across a scene (props, light, wardrobe)
music only when the swipe or the brief calls for it, never fighting the voice
why_new: new family because nearest vo-explainer at 0.7 < 0.75
